scope: Subsequent processing, peak-yield extraction and plotting of the corrected p1/p2 data
variance_assumptions: Independent unweighted prompt/random counts; alpha fixed; additional correlations and systematic uncertainties handled separately
combined_spectrum: Sum separately subtracted groups; sum their conditional variances
input_requirement: Unsubtracted prompt and random counts from corrected e_dc_r; never treat an already-subtracted histogram as prompt
coefficient_basis: Explicit user choice; no new timing-normalization calibration
historical_results: Retain the actual alpha used; do not relabel old fits or F3 as using this policy
